name: Ziph
overview: Ziph refers to two cities within the territory of the tribe of Judah, as noted in Joshua 15:24 and 15:55, highlighting its geographical significance. It is also identified as the wilderness area where David sought refuge from Saul, who persistently pursued him but was repeatedly thwarted by God's protection (1 Samuel 23:14-15, 23:24, 26:2). This setting emphasizes God's providential care over David during times of trial and the historical importance of Ziph in the narrative of Israel's early monarchy.
